items.label: config.json filled (vault + inbox paths)
items.next_action: Copy config.example.json to config.json and fill in the four paths.

items.label: API access token set
items.next_action: Set a random string as api.auth_token in config.json.

items.label: whisper.cpp installed and runnable
items.next_action: brew install whisper-cpp, download the small.en model, put both paths in config.json.

items.label: A classification model key set
items.next_action: export at least one of GEMINI_API_KEY / GROQ_API_KEY / OPENROUTER_API_KEY / ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the server's shell.

items.label: Your voice taught (drafts refuse without it)
items.next_action: Cockpit → Settings → My voice: paste 3–5 messages you have actually sent. Until this exists, drafting refuses rather than sounding like a chatbot.

items.label: Hindi → Hinglish engine picked
items.next_action: Settings → Hindi → Hinglish: pick Ollama (local, name the model) or OpenRouter (needs OPENROUTER_API_KEY). Unset is a fine state — Hindi notes are simply kept in Devanagari.

items.label: Plaud watch folder set (hands-off ingest)
items.next_action: Check the real recordings folder in Plaud Desktop → Preferences, then add it to watch_folders in config.json. Optional — the share-to-inbox path works without it.

items.label: Dex API key set (profile push)
items.name: DEX_API_KEY
items.next_action: export DEX_API_KEY=… in the server's shell to enable Push to Dex. Everything else on the People screen works without it.

items.label: Google contacts permission granted
items.next_action: Integrations → Disconnect, then Connect Google again. It's a one-time re-consent that adds permission to update your contacts' notes.

items.label: ntfy push configured
items.next_action: Fill ntfy.url and ntfy.topic in config.json, subscribe on your phone, then send a test push from Integrations.

items.label: Vault git-sync to a private repo configured
items.next_action: Create a private GitHub repo for the vault, then set VAULT_GIT_REMOTE and VAULT_GIT_TOKEN (Railway service variables, or vault_sync.remote in config.json for a Mac/compose deploy). Optional on a single-machine setup — essential once more than one machine opens the vault.

items.label: Whisper model present on this machine
items.next_action: On a cloud deploy: set OPENAI_API_KEY to use cloud transcription instead, or download the whisper.cpp small.en model onto the volume (DEPLOY.md).

items.label: → Brain Cloud Shortcut installed
items.next_action: Build the “→ Brain Cloud” Shortcut on your iPhone (Help §08d has the exact recipe), test it once, then set deploy.shortcut_installed to true in config.json. Only your phone can prove this, which is why it's manual.

items.label: Docker artifacts present
items.next_action: Run the Pass 10 build session (Dockerfile + compose + DEPLOY.md).

items.label: docker-compose.yml present
items.next_action: Run the Pass 10 build session (Dockerfile + compose + DEPLOY.md).

items.label: launchd agents installed (Mac path)
items.next_action: On the Mac: bash deploy/launchd/install.sh (DEPLOY.md Path B). Off-Mac this stays unticked — that's expected.

items.label: Cloudflare tunnel configured
items.next_action: Create the tunnel + hostname (DEPLOY.md, tunnel section), then record the hostname in config.json → deploy.tunnel_hostname.

items.label: Claude Desktop MCP connected
items.next_action: Add the brain-cockpit block from the Operating Manual (§MCP) to your Claude Desktop config with COCKPIT_URL and COCKPIT_TOKEN, restart Claude Desktop, ask it for your cockpit status — then set deploy.mcp_connected to true in config.json. Only Claude Desktop can prove this, which is why it's manual.

items.label: Reachable from the internet (manual check)
items.next_action: From a phone on mobile data, open https://<your-hostname>/api/health through the Access login; when it answers, record the URL in config.json → deploy.public_url. Only a device outside your LAN can prove this — that's why it's manual.

items.label: Backlog ritual run
items.next_action: Run the Backlog Ritual: .venv/bin/python -m pipeline --backlog (Operating Manual §04).

items.label: Backlog cleared (CaptureInbox empty)
items.next_action: Keep running --backlog batches until the capture inbox is empty.

items.label: First real capture processed
items.next_action: Record a voice memo, share it to → Brain, and let the watcher process it.

items.label: 30-day clock started
items.next_action: The clock starts the day the backlog is clear AND a real capture has landed (Manual §04/§06).
